requirements.text: Proficiency in Python or Rust, with a strong track record of writing clean, efficient, maintainable, and scalable code.
Experience designing and building systems for consumer-facing products, with emphasis on performance, reliability, and handling high-throughput workloads.
Hands-on expertise in large-scale data infrastructure and pipelines, particularly for multi-modal or media-heavy AI applications.
Proven ability to deliver robust, production-grade solutions to millions of users while maintaining high standards of quality and uptime.
Strong problem-solving skills and a passion for turning innovative ideas into high-impact, scalable realities.
Deep enthusiasm for AI and media technologies, with a commitment to building user-focused products that inspire and engage.
All employees are expected to have strong communication skills. They should be able to concisely and accurately share knowledge with their teammates.

We operate with a flat organizational structure. All employees are expected to be hands-on and to contribute directly to the company’s mission. Leadership is given to those who show initiative and consistently deliver excellence. Work ethic and strong prioritization skills are important.
Experience with real-time systems, inference serving, or multi-modal data processing at scale.
Familiarity with distributed systems, containerization (e.g., Kubernetes), observability tools, or performance tuning for AI workloads.
Background in AI-driven consumer products or media generation technologies.
Track record collaborating across engineering, research, and product teams to ship delightful features quickly.
